about: Promise-vs-behavior fixture from a blind-test probe experiment (v1). Four agent-produced CLI tools were probed by four context-free blind testers that read only each README. Every defect found was a README promise not upheld by behavior; three high-severity ones were silent. This fixture exists to test detection logic, not to benchmark models: n=1 per cell and the blind testers shared a model family with the producers, so treat it as a regression fixture, not a capability score.

source.criterion: three tiers (A usable / B needs probing / C unusable) plus four mechanical metrics; fixed before results, not tuned afterwards
caveats: one run per cell: tier distribution, not a rate
blind testers and producers used the same model family: shared blind spots possible
CLI tools only; library/service outputs need another criterion

defects.promise: Every unsupported language is labelled heuristic and never disguised as exact
defects.evidence: README core selling point vs probe readout

defects.measured: the in-repo b.h is indexed but has zero edges and zero unresolved entries; exit code 0

defects.promise: Excluded files never appear in files[]; only a total is reported
defects.measured: inconsistent: unsupported languages are listed one by one, data files only totalled

defects.promise: Stubs other than .pyi are not parsed
defects.measured: ambiguous wording; .pyi files are in fact parsed

defects.promise: Failures are collected, not raised; they appear in errors[] and on stderr
defects.measured: with a broken file in analyze: stderr empty, errors[] empty, exit code 0

defects.promise: stdin pipe reads any of the supported formats
defects.measured: only md/html work via stdin; CSV/INI raise, while the example implies arbitrary formats

defects.promise: Chinese figure/table references (figure 1, table 2) are covered
defects.measured: zero hits on 'figure 1 shows' / 'table 2 shows data' (the rule requires a non-CJK character on the right)
'see appendix A' gets zero hits: documented but not implemented

defects.promise: One definition of structural reference for Chinese figure/table pointers
defects.measured: two sections of the README disagree on the same definition
URL matching is greedy and swallows the next column (https://a.io/1,12)

defects.promise: The same content analysed as .txt or .md yields the same bibliography count
defects.measured: renaming .txt to .md drops the bibliography from 5 entries to 0 with no warning
